_comment: Official-compatible Ubuntu Gazebo profile: single source of the values copied from OFFICIAL_SIM_SPEC.md (verified) and of every ASSUMPTION (marked). Read by gen_model.py, oak_sim_driver.py, ev_bridge.py, check_compat.py.

airframe.name: Sky Beta (approx.)
airframe._assumed: rotor centres at (+-0.10, +-0.10): extent along x/y = 0.10 + 0.089 prop radius = 0.19 m ~ planner half span 0.20; inertia scaled from a 7in quad; base_link 5 cm above the floor at rest (mission_node floor_d = pos + 0.05)

camera._assumed: right = left - baseline along body y (official TF for oak_right not yet captured); oak_rgb between the mono pair; zero distortion

depth._assumed: rendered depth (no stereo matching), invalid -> 0.0; near/far clip 0.20/12 m (OAK-D S2 class); arena net and tunnel black mesh invisible to depth (venue_depth convention)

imu._assumed: topic name /oak/imu; axes = body FLU; located between the mono cameras; BMI270-class noise

range._assumed: PX4-side downward ToF just ahead of the body (sensor roll 180 deg + 90 deg beam so PX4 GZBridge reports ROTATION_DOWNWARD_FACING when level), VL53L1X-class 0.02-4 m; 4 cm above the floor at rest

physics._assumed: 480 Hz physics so the OAK IMU can run at 480 Hz (official: 240 Hz PhysX + 480 Hz IMU)
